scientific_integrity: The claims are supported by explicit finite matrix sign factorizations and an all-length Fourier moment argument. Finite experiments only corroborate the analytic proof; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact restoring-strength thresholds are shown only for lengths four through six; each finite larger length has eventual recovery, but no general closed threshold or growth law is proved. Historical finite-sample filter-weight literature may contain unrecognized equivalent consequences; one relevant 2016 full text was inaccessible.
title: Exact finite-sample monotonicity thresholds and the nonuniformity barrier for second-difference smoothing
